By separating the normalization of each reward, GDPO alleviates the information-loss problem present in GRPO’s advantage estimation, as illustrated in Fig. 2 . Note that since the batch-wise normalization step in GDPO does not alter the number of distinct advantage groups, we omit it here for clarity. From the figure, we can see that when adopting GRPO, distinct reward combinations, such as ( 0 , 2 ) (0,2) and ( 0 , 1 ) (0,1) , lead to identical normalized advantages, masking the subtle distinctions between them.
